abilities.name: Poltergeist
abilities.effect: Rotom gains an Ability depending on what Form it has taken. If Rotom is level 40 or higher, it also may use a Move based on its Forme as if it that Move was on their Move List. abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Electric Type attacks. Whenever an Electric Type attack hits the Pokémon, raise their Speed by +1 Combat Stage. Defensive.
